d: This time Writer, lyricist and poet Javed Akhtar appears in Lallantop's Weekly Show Guest in the newsroom. This Special episode was Guest in the Newsroom as well as Kitabwala. In this episode Javed Akhtar alongwith Arvind Mandloi Talked about Recently launched book Jadunama written on Javed Akhtar's life. Apart from this, Javed Akhtar talks about his early life, studies, initial days in Bollywood and his experiences as a poet. Javed Saheb also shared an anecdote related to Faiz Ahmed Faiz and former Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru. Watch this full episode of Guest in the Newsroom.
